title: SAMPLE: GNU-attributed remarks on facility guards, not an independent finding
summary: A sample statement attributed to a GNU spokesperson commented on oil-facility guards. The remarks are recorded as attribution, not as verified fact.
whatHappened: A sample press note attributed to a GNU spokesperson said arrangements for facility guards would be reviewed. No implementing decree or NOC confirmation was attached.
whyItMatters: Guard arrangements can affect terminal access. Attributed political remarks are not the same as a change on the ground.
watchNext: A written decision, an NOC comment, or evidence of an actual change at a named facility.
confidenceRationale: Clear attribution to a named institutional voice; the underlying policy change is unverified.

disputedClaims.claim: Facility-guard arrangements will change in the near term.
disputedClaims.note: Recorded as an attributed statement. No implementing text seen.
